name: paper-orchestra-studio
description: Local AI scientific paper pipeline with Best-Paper L1-L8 narrative routing, 19 LaTeX venue templates, Overleaf-style side-by-side XeLaTeX & bidirectional SyncTeX workbench, abstract field diagnosis & sentence change-table copilot, author report.md delivery, Desktop TCP bridge, Nature + award-paper style/figure & Lean 4 audits, 8-source literature graph, 5+5 SOP skills, region-circle figure studio, interactive HTML/Word/PDF export, and SSH/GPU management.

paper_orchestra_repo.title: PaperOrchestra Backend Directory (Optional)
paper_orchestra_repo.description: Path to paper-orchestra/ containing paper_writing_cli.py. Leave blank to auto-detect from Desktop App SQLite settings or ~/paper-orchestra.

paper_orchestra_python.title: Backend Python Executable (Optional)
paper_orchestra_python.description: Path to .venv Python interpreter (e.g. paper-orchestra/.venv/bin/python). Leave blank to auto-detect.

default_pdf_dir.title: Default PDF Output Directory (Optional)
default_pdf_dir.description: Default folder for standalone exported PDF reports when no explicit path is supplied.

default_html_dir.title: Default HTML Output Directory (Optional)
default_html_dir.description: Default folder for standalone interactive HTML reports when no explicit path is supplied.

tools.name: po_check_environment
tools.description: Check backend paths, Python runtime, TeX Live/MacTeX, Pandoc, Chrome, Lean 4, SSH/SCP, export directories, and SQLite counts.

tools.name: po_check_providers
tools.description: Check 20+ configured LLM platforms, custom providers.json, and 8 scholarly search sources.

tools.name: po_list_templates
tools.description: List all 19 conference, journal, Chinese GB/T 7714, and mathematical modeling LaTeX templates with venue.json style rules.

tools.name: po_parse_intake_form
tools.description: Parse PaperOrchestra project intake forms (.pdf, .docx, .md, .txt) into structured fields.

tools.name: po_projects
tools.description: Create, list, read, update, and delete SQLite paper projects, figures, and historical runs.

tools.name: po_start_paper_run
tools.description: Start or resume a multi-agent paper generation pipeline with optional 19-step model overrides.

tools.name: po_job_manage
tools.description: List background jobs, inspect live stage/token usage, tail redacted logs, or stop running jobs.

tools.name: po_inspect_run
tools.description: Inspect run directory outputs (PDF, TeX, citation audit, usage report, peer reviews) or read artifact files.

tools.name: po_data_analysis
tools.description: Profile tabular datasets offline or run the 7-step reproducible self-fixing analysis pipeline.

tools.name: po_run_sop
tools.description: Run the 5 scientific SOPs: paper_reading, lit_review, topic_ideation, reproduction, and math_modeling.

tools.name: po_custom_skills
tools.description: List, save, delete, fetch from GitHub/HTTPS URLs, and run custom Markdown research skills.

tools.name: po_figure_studio
tools.description: Create 3-route figures, register versioned bundles, apply bbox region-circle local edits, or restore versions.

tools.name: po_literature_library
tools.description: Search 8 scholarly sources, import DOI/PDF into SQLite, build knowledge graphs, and export BibTeX/GB7714.

tools.name: po_latex_copilot
tools.description: AI LaTeX editing copilot (`edit`), inline claim-to-citation traceability (`trace_citations`), and award-paper abstract diagnosis + sentence change-table polishing (`polish_abstract`).

tools.name: po_latex_workbench
tools.description: Conflict-safe LaTeX co-editing (`open`, `read`, `save`, `restore`), auto-CJK XeLaTeX compile, bidirectional SyncTeX (`sync_view` multi-line highlight & `sync_edit` click-to-jump), and Overleaf ZIP export.

tools.name: po_submission_audit
tools.description: Pre-submission audits & author report: Nature + award-paper AI-rhythm/figure `manuscript-audit`, `author-report` (`report.md`), `cite-online`, `arxiv`, `blind`, `diagnose`, `versions`, `diff`, `lean-audit`.

tools.name: po_revision_toolkit
tools.description: Deterministic reviewer-comment matrix, venue preflight (limits, placeholders, anonymity, statements), Crossref retraction check, and reporting-guideline checklists

tools.name: po_export_document
tools.description: Export Markdown reports to interactive Claude Artifacts-style HTML, Word (.docx), PDF, or Google Drive.

tools.name: po_compute_and_memory
tools.description: Manage persistent Research Memories/Preferences and remote SSH/GPU hosts (nvidia-smi, ssh exec, scp).

tools.name: po_studio_bridge
tools.description: Connect to running PaperOrchestra Studio desktop app over loopback TCP (`status`, `open_studio`, bridge jobs, integrations launcher).

tools.name: po_settings_and_setup
tools.description: Manage SQLite app settings, validate `providers.json`, check 20-platform boolean credential readiness, and discover backend setup scripts.

tools.name: po_open_workbench
tools.description: Open the interactive PaperOrchestra Studio Workbench UI (projects, pipeline monitor, Canvas intervention, Figure bbox bench, Overleaf-style side-by-side LaTeX/PDF SyncTeX editor, abstract polish change-table, and report.md export).

tools.name: po_open_tool_tree
tools.description: Open the interactive PaperOrchestra Studio 10-group Tool Tree reference and delegation UI.
